author: DaiqingChen
body: * **The annotations of collagen type IX trimer (GO:0005594) within homo sapients are as follow:** Contain COL9A1, COL9A2, COL9A3, COL13A1, COL16A1. * **Gene product name to be annotated to this term** Should only contain COL9A1, COL9A2, COL9A3 in all species. Need to remove: COL13A1 and COL16A1 in all species, there are also quite some mis-annotation in other species. These annotations are inferred from phylogenetic tree, should only keep collagen type 9 gene product.
title: Update gene product of collagen type IX trimer

author: pgaudet
body:
I reviewed the entire family ([PTHR24023](https://www.pantherdb.org/panther/family.do?clsAccession=PTHR24023)

There are a number of proteins that does seem to be collagens, so I removed the annotations from those: 
- [MARCO](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9UEW3/entry) 
- [OTOL1](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/A6NHN0/entry) 
- [COLQ](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9Y215/entry)


Please reopen if you see other problems. Note that this will take a few weeks to be in the public data. 

Thanks, Pascale
